beats.headline: The quest gets a name
beats.text: Samantha goes across the water to look at the far shore and finds the team over there dead. All of them, and all of them by one thing. The Recital quest updates with the name it has been withholding. Big Tina. Allosaurus, level 80, immortalized city boss, and the attacks on Point Mongo have been hers from the beginning.

beats.headline: Prepotente Town #4
beats.text: Carl and Princess Donut take two more towns and arrive at a third to claim it. There is not much left of the third. She has already been through it, and there is a pattern to which places she visits that nobody has sat down and read yet.

beats.headline: What she actually wants
beats.text: The party goes back into the town for Miriam and finds Big Tina standing in it again, and this time the shape of the thing comes clear. The dinosaurs of the Hunting Grounds were ursine before Scolopendra's nine-tier attack turned them into what they are. Tina was a child when it happened. What she wants, under all of it, is to dance at a recital, because hers was stopped before her turn came. She is also a vampire now, and she is building undead out of what she brings down.

beats.headline: The pile down the street
beats.text: Big Tina has not been idle in the street. She has been calling the two-day-dead to her, and other dinosaurs have been hauling body parts in from the whole forest into a heap like a sorting facility, where the fragments crawl about finding their matches. Levels add as the pieces rejoin, and at seventy percent of the whole a body becomes something quite deadly. One fragment has reached level 42 at 21.8%. Carl sets missiles on the pile and leaves. She roars. She does not follow.

beats.headline: She is brought in, and does nothing
beats.text: The dinosaur squad comes back to Carl and Princess Donut with Big Tina walking in behind them, and everybody in the clearing braces for the obvious. The obvious does not happen. Kiwi puts herself between the boss and the crawlers, and Tina stops. Nobody present can yet say why that works.

beats.headline: The dot turns white
beats.text: Tina gives up on eating the party and wanders off howling, half the pack behind her. She comes back into the light of Princess Donut's spell, head low, and tries to hide behind a tree like a shy child. Kiwi walks over, grunts at Mongo to come too, and he creeps up with Princess Donut on his back, head to the ground. Tina sniffs at him from a distance while her mother stands between them squawking. Her dot blinks from red to white.

beats.headline: Her mother has been there all along
beats.text: Everyone on the Hunting Grounds who knows Tina's story knows what she wants, Signet tells Carl, and it is not to dance in a recital. She wants her mother back. Carl says her mother is Kiwi, the mongoliensis. Signet agrees. Tina's mind is gone, and she does not realise that the other dinosaur has been there the whole time. She already has what she wants; she only needs to see it. What Carl has planned for tonight is close, Signet says, but not quite right.

beats.headline: The recital, finally
beats.text: In the middle of the battle Princess Donut puts the I Take It All Back potion on Kiwi, and the pack leader is not a mongoliensis any more. An ursine stands there, naked but for the paper bubbles. Tina looks at her and knows her, and the Recital quest closes on the spot. It was never a quest about a monster. Nobody reading the log had any way of knowing that.

beats.headline: Out again, in a tutu
beats.text: Carl adds his strength to the fortress's oversized, badly hammered door, and it flies all the way open and throws him and Tipid to the ground. Someone shouts that she is out again. Big Tina, allosaurus, wearing a pink tutu, stamps into the clearing and hops up and down in front of Mongo, waving her little wand. Mongo hops up and down in front of her too.

beats.headline: Her mother says no
beats.text: Carl sends for Tina and her mother refuses. Too dangerous, Kiwi says; she's just a child, and Carl has just ordered the gnome and the changeling children out of the battle, so why is Tina different? Carl writes an order overriding her, looks at it, and deletes it, and decides it is Kiwi's call. Donut does not. GET TINA OUT HERE RIGHT NOW, in the warlord chat, and before Kiwi can answer the doors fly open and Tina comes out screeching with glee, waving her wand, and starts eating the invisible enemies.

beats.headline: Too big for the saferoom doors
beats.text: She came out of the ball and went straight to work: a fire lance tower taken out single-handed, and dozens of crawlers kept from burning alive, her ever-repairing feather boa black and scorched for it. Now she stands on a pile of rocks waving her wand at her mother. Kiwi, heavily pregnant, has come from the FUPA to take her back. Florin doubts it. She is too big for the saferoom doors down here, and the stairs are blown out. Mongo bounces in circles around her.
